title: juglans jamaicensis subsp. insularis
intro: Juglans jamaicensis subsp. insularis, commonly known as Jamaican walnut, is a subspecies of the walnut tree that is native to Jamaica. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Jamaican walnut are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive compounds found in Jamaican walnut may also contribute to its use in traditional medicine for the treatment of various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues.
